summary: Own or explicitly exclude unpublishable root paths (CHANGELOG, .env.example)

delivery.outcome: Adopt an immutable standard release that assigns CHANGELOG.md and .env.example to the governance workstream, or implement the explicitly approved exclusion fallback
nonGoals: No silent ownership expansion without standard alignment
No direct mutation of hash-locked managed files
No moving tag or branch-based adoption

architecture.decision: Prefer upstream Option A: make CHANGELOG.md and .env.example governance-owned in a new immutable new-project release, then adopt it through Goal

components.name: upstream-standard
paths: wellmanifest/new-project governance manifest and regression tests

interfaceChanges: The governance workstream becomes the sole owner of CHANGELOG.md and .env.example
dataChanges: The governance lock advances from 0.11.0 to an approved immutable release
architecture.rollback: Adopt the prior immutable source revision through the same reviewed Goal flow; never move or rewrite a release tag

validation.evidence: Managed ownership declarations and target intent pass governance validation

commands: upstream focused ownership regression command selected by the approved upstream ticket
validation.evidence: A non-governance claim for either root path fails closed
Adoption is pinned, idempotent and leaves host and Docker checks green
